description: Allow the SpecOps console (loaded from a loopback HTTP origin) to drag and maximize its own window. The SpecOps Rail renders a `data-tauri-drag-region` strip; Tauri's injected drag.js calls `plugin:window|start_dragging` / `internal_toggle_maximize` over IPC. Because the console is an EXTERNAL (remote) URL, those window commands are denied unless the origin is listed under `remote.urls` here. Scope is intentionally narrow: only the two drag/maximize commands, only for specops-* windows, only from the loopback origin.
